name: The Dolls' Stories
source:
Congratulations, you have become just become a state puppeteer -- that is, a soldier with the license to own a magical doll! Magical dolls are awesome things that are nurtured from young to BAMF, so you can look forward to getting either a hot dude or a cute chick. As time passes, however, you find that your doll isn't growing up as he or she should be...

[From [URL=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?t=17876]Lemma Soft Forums[/URL]]
translation:
恭喜你，你刚刚成为一名国家人偶师——也就是拥有魔法人偶的资格、能够持有魔法人偶的士兵！

魔法人偶从小培养，最终会成长为强大的存在，因此你可以期待得到一个性感男孩或可爱女孩。

然而，随着时间流逝，你发现自己的魔法人偶似乎没有按照应有的方式长大……

[来自 [URL=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?t=17876]Lemma Soft 论坛[/URL]]
